coverage_gaps: The permitted routes omit sponsor clinical-study reports, EMA or other non-FDA regulator assessments, journal full-text platforms, and raw individual-participant data, which may limit verification of unpublished analyses and detailed adjudication methods.
Rare-event estimates and subgroup findings may remain imprecise, multiplicity-sensitive, or underpowered even after all routed evidence is exhausted.
The cardiovascular-risk-enriched ORAL Surveillance population may limit direct generalization to younger patients or patients without baseline cardiovascular risk factors.
FDA web archives and historical label versions may be incomplete or difficult to date precisely; any unrecovered version should remain an explicit timeline gap.
PubMed indexing of corrections, expressions of concern, and retractions can lag publisher action, so absence of a routed notice cannot establish absolute absence of a publisher-side change.
exclusion_criteria: Records first made public after 2024-12-31 are excluded from the as-of synthesis.
Preclinical, mechanistic, pharmacokinetic, and animal studies without direct clinical safety estimates are excluded.
Studies confined to non-rheumatoid-arthritis indications are excluded unless they directly underpin an FDA action governing marketed rheumatoid arthritis use.
Reports lacking separable tofacitinib results or lacking any cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, or mortality outcome are excluded.
Narrative commentary, editorials, news reports, and nonofficial summaries are excluded as effect evidence, although they may be used only to locate an eligible primary source.
Uncontrolled case reports and spontaneous-event counts without a denominator are excluded from comparative risk estimation; any use as signal context must be explicitly segregated.
Duplicate abstracts or interim reports are excluded when a complete peer-reviewed or registry result for the same analysis is available, with provenance links retained.
Analyses that combine JAK inhibitors without a separable tofacitinib estimate are excluded from drug-specific conclusions.
Retracted evidence is excluded from effect synthesis and retained only in the integrity ledger; corrected evidence is represented by the corrected version with the original notice linked.
Registry outcomes or publication claims that cannot be reconciled on population, arm, endpoint, or follow-up are excluded from pooled interpretation until the discrepancy is resolved.
inclusion_criteria: Evidence must have been publicly available on or before 2024-12-31; later online-first, registry, or regulatory updates are excluded even if they describe earlier events.
The core evidence chain must include the ClinicalTrials.gov record for NCT02092467, the primary peer-reviewed report, and FDA communications or labeling actions that explicitly rely on the trial.
Clinical evidence must concern marketed tofacitinib exposure in rheumatoid arthritis or directly inform an FDA action applicable to marketed rheumatoid arthritis use.
Studies must report at least one prespecified safety domain: major cardiovascular events, malignancy, venous or arterial thrombosis, or all-cause or cause-specific mortality.
Primary randomized results are eligible regardless of direction; secondary and post hoc analyses are eligible when clearly labeled and linked to the pivotal study population.
External evidence is eligible when it provides a relevant comparator or expected-rate context and reports sufficient population, exposure, endpoint, and follow-up information to judge applicability.
FDA sources are eligible when they are official safety communications, approval or postmarketing records, or prescribing-information versions with identifiable dates and action language.
Publication-integrity notices are included whenever they correct, withdraw, qualify, or cast doubt on an otherwise eligible evidence item.
For duplicate reports of the same analysis, the most complete version is retained while all identifiers and correction links are preserved for provenance.
Effect estimates are included with their denominators, confidence intervals, dose assignments, endpoint definitions, and analysis status whenever those data are available.

queries.purpose: Retrieve the authoritative registry record, sponsor protocol identifier, design, arms, endpoints, dates, enrollment, amendments, results, and linked publications for the pivotal postauthorization study.
Identify the primary publication and the complete indexed publication family directly tied to the pivotal study.
queries.query: ("NCT02092467"[All Fields] OR "A3921133"[All Fields] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[All Fields]) AND tofacitinib[All Fields]

queries.purpose: Locate FDA communications explicitly tied to the pivotal trial and establish the regulatory action timeline.
queries.query: tofacitinib OR Xeljanz NCT02092467 ORAL Surveillance FDA safety communication

queries.purpose: Confirm the primary publication identity, bibliographic record, publication types, DOI, abstracted estimates, and linked notices.
queries.query: "Cardiovascular and Cancer Risk with Tofacitinib in Rheumatoid Arthritis"[Title]

queries.purpose: Confirm that the sentinel registry record is the intended comparative postauthorization safety trial and detect duplicate or related registrations.
queries.query: AREA[InterventionName]tofacitinib AND AREA[ConditionSearch]rheumatoid arthritis AND (AREA[OfficialTitle]safety OR AREA[BriefTitle]safety)

queries.purpose: Recover the early FDA alert concerning thrombosis and mortality during the ongoing safety trial.
queries.query: site:fda.gov tofacitinib February 2019 blood clots death safety trial

queries.purpose: Confirm the subsequent boxed-warning action, affected dose, stated evidence basis, and indicated populations.
queries.query: site:fda.gov tofacitinib July 2019 boxed warning blood clots death 10 mg twice daily

queries.purpose: Confirm FDA interpretation of the completed trial's preliminary cardiovascular and malignancy results.
queries.query: site:fda.gov tofacitinib February 2021 initial results serious heart-related problems cancer safety trial

queries.purpose: Capture the class-wide FDA action, indication restriction, boxed-warning changes, and rationale arising from the tofacitinib trial.
queries.query: site:fda.gov September 2021 JAK inhibitors serious heart-related events cancer blood clots death tofacitinib

queries.purpose: Verify the final marketed labeling through the as-of date, including indication, dosing, patient selection, and warnings for the four outcome domains.
queries.query: site:accessdata.fda.gov Xeljanz tofacitinib prescribing information boxed warning 2021 2022 2023 2024

queries.purpose: Find pivotal-study cardiovascular analyses, including subgroup and risk-stratification work that may qualify the primary estimate.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] AND rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract]) AND (cardiovascular OR MACE OR myocardial infarction OR stroke) AND (NCT02092467 OR "ORAL Surveillance")

queries.purpose: Find detailed malignancy analyses addressing cancer type, latency, baseline risk, and subgroup effects.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] AND rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract]) AND (malignancy OR cancer OR lymphoma OR "lung cancer") AND (NCT02092467 OR "ORAL Surveillance")

queries.purpose: Find analyses of venous and arterial thrombosis, dose relationships, risk factors, and event definitions.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] AND rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract]) AND (thrombosis OR thromboembolism OR "pulmonary embolism" OR VTE) AND (NCT02092467 OR "ORAL Surveillance")

queries.purpose: Identify all-cause and cause-specific mortality reporting within the pivotal-study publication family.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] AND rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract]) AND (mortality OR death OR fatal) AND (NCT02092467 OR "ORAL Surveillance")

queries.purpose: Retrieve external comparative real-world evidence that can corroborate, qualify, or conflict with the pivotal trial while preserving population and comparator differences.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] AND rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract]) AND (observational OR cohort OR registry OR claims OR "real world") AND (cardiovascular OR malignancy OR cancer OR thrombosis OR thromboembolism OR mortality)

queries.purpose: Find evidence syntheses and broader randomized evidence relevant to consistency, heterogeneity, class effects, and limitations of rare-event inference.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR "JAK inhibitor"[Title/Abstract]) AND rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract] AND (meta-analysis[Publication Type] OR systematic review[Title/Abstract]) AND (cardiovascular OR malignancy OR thrombosis OR mortality)

queries.purpose: Deliberately seek null, discordant, subgroup-specific, or comparator-sensitive findings that challenge an overly broad interpretation of ORAL Surveillance.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] AND rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract]) AND ("TNF inhibitor" OR adalimumab OR etanercept) AND (no increased risk OR comparable OR conflicting OR discordant OR interaction OR subgroup)

queries.purpose: Detect corrections, errata, retractions, or expressions of concern attached to the primary study or its linked analyses.
queries.query: ("NCT02092467"[All Fields] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[All Fields] OR "Cardiovascular and Cancer Risk with Tofacitinib in Rheumatoid Arthritis"[All Fields]) AND (Correction[Publication Type] OR Retracted Publication[Publication Type] OR Retraction of Publication[Publication Type] OR "expression of concern"[All Fields] OR erratum[All Fields])

queries.purpose: Check publication-integrity status for qualifying external safety evidence, including notices not indexed under the trial identifier.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] AND rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract]) AND (Correction[Publication Type] OR Retracted Publication[Publication Type] OR Retraction of Publication[Publication Type] OR "expression of concern"[All Fields] OR erratum[All Fields]) AND (cardiovascular OR malignancy OR cancer OR thrombosis OR mortality)

queries.purpose: Review registry version history through the cutoff for amendments, delayed result changes, adverse-event tables, and newly linked publications that could alter interpretation.
queries.query: NCT02092467 history changes results adverse events publications

queries.purpose: Identify corrected, superseded, updated, or archived FDA communications and preserve the temporal relationship among preliminary and final regulatory conclusions.
queries.query: site:fda.gov tofacitinib correction update archive safety communication heart cancer blood clots death

queries.purpose: Capture post-primary-publication analyses and evidence available by the as-of date without admitting later publications.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] AND rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract]) AND (cardiovascular OR malignancy OR cancer OR thrombosis OR thromboembolism OR mortality) AND ("2022/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

question_frame: As of 2024-12-31, assess the cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, and all-cause mortality safety of marketed tofacitinib for rheumatoid arthritis, centering the postauthorization ORAL Surveillance study in patients aged at least 50 years with cardiovascular risk factors. Establish a traceable linkage among protocol A3921133/NCT02092467, its registry history and results, the primary publication, and ensuing FDA communications and labeling actions; distinguish randomized primary findings from secondary or post hoc analyses and external observational or synthesized evidence; evaluate dose, comparator, population-risk, endpoint-definition, follow-up, multiplicity, and precision limitations; identify evidence that qualifies or conflicts with the pivotal findings; and verify correction, erratum, expression-of-concern, and retraction status for every publication used.
stop_rules: Stop sentinel searching only after NCT02092467/A3921133 is linked bidirectionally to the primary publication by registry or publication identifiers and its design, arms, endpoints, dates, and results status are captured.

Stop FDA confirmation only after the 2019 thrombosis and mortality actions, the 2021 cardiovascular and cancer communication, the subsequent class-wide warning or indication restriction, and the latest label available by 2024-12-31 are located or their absence is documented.

For each of the four safety domains, stop discovery after the pivotal estimate and at least one eligible qualifying analysis or external evidence stream are found, or after two consecutive query refinements yield no new eligible evidence.

Stop challenge searching only after at least one targeted null or discordant-evidence query has been run for each safety domain and differences in population, dose, comparator, follow-up, or endpoint definition have been assessed.

Stop integrity checking only after PubMed publication types and linked-record notices are examined for every included publication and FDA pages are checked for update, correction, supersession, or archive language.
Stop registry review after the current record, results tables, adverse-event tables, linked publications, and relevant history entries through 2024-12-31 have been examined.
Stop expansion when two consecutive source-specific query waves add no new eligible study, regulatory action, outcome definition, material subgroup, or publication-integrity notice.
Do not stop solely because point estimates align; continue until precision, multiplicity, dose, comparator, baseline-risk, and generalizability limitations are represented.
Freeze the evidence set at the as-of date, deduplicate by trial or underlying cohort and analysis, preserve every query-to-record link, and document unresolved discrepancies as coverage gaps.
